series.name: Association for Education Finance and Policy Annual Conference
series.organizer: Association for Education Finance and Policy (AEFP)
series.notes: Important dates at https://aefpweb.org/conference-dates. Submissions via Oxford Abstracts.

series.name: APPAM Fall Research Conference
series.organizer: Association for Public Policy Analysis & Management (APPAM)
series.associated_journal: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
series.notes: Public policy conference (all policy areas). A separate Late-Breaking Roundtable call runs late August to late September.

series.name: International Workshop on Applied Economics of Education (IWAEE)
series.organizer: Magna Graecia University of Catanzaro, with Lancaster University and NTNU
series.notes: Held in Catanzaro (Calabria), Italy. 2026 fees: EUR 405, EUR 300 for PhD students.

series.name: ABFER Annual Conference (Labour Economics; Real Estate and Urban Economics; Tech, Digital Markets and AI programs)
series.organizer: Asian Bureau of Finance and Economic Research (ABFER)
series.site_note: Call for papers posted on the annual-conference page (2026 call: https://www.abfer.org/events/abfer-events/annual-conference/417:accfp2026).
series.notes: Multi-program conference, mostly finance; only the Labour Economics, Real Estate and Urban Economics (joint with IREUS) and Tech, Digital Markets and AI programs are in scope. Fee waived for presenters and discussants; capped sponsorship for one author and one discussant per paper.

series.name: EEA-ESEM Congress (EEA Annual Congress and European Summer Meeting of the Econometric Society)
series.organizer: European Economic Association (EEA) and Econometric Society (ES)
series.site_note: Host city rotates. The EEA page links to the congress site https://www.eea-esem-congresses.org/ (reused each year); the Econometric Society event page for each edition posts submission dates first. EEA submissions go through congresscreator.org, ES submissions through Oxford Abstracts.
series.associated_journal: Journal of the European Economic Association; Econometrica
series.notes: Full papers only (no abstracts). One paper per author to each of the EEA and ES sessions; at least one co-author must be a member of the association submitted to. 2026 registration EUR 495 members / EUR 990 non-members. 2027: Prague, 23-27 Aug.

series.name: Royal Economic Society Annual Conference
series.organizer: Royal Economic Society (RES)
series.site_note: Each year has its own event page (e.g. https://res.org.uk/event-listing/res2027/), linked from the conference overview page.
series.typical_deadline: Mid/late January (General Sessions); April (Speed and Poster Sessions)
series.associated_journal: The Economic Journal; The Econometrics Journal
series.notes: Rotates across UK universities. No submission fee; RES membership not required to submit. Abstract plus (draft) paper required. 2027: University of Reading, 28-30 Jun.

series.name: European Winter Meeting of the Econometric Society (EWMES)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Open to all (best-paper award limited to authors within two years of PhD). One paper per presenter; at least one author must be an ES member. 2027: Université libre de Bruxelles, 16-18 Dec.

series.name: AEA/ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: American Economic Association (AEA) / Allied Social Science Associations (ASSA)
series.notes: Abstract-only submissions (max. 300 words); at least one author must be an AEA member. Future meetings: Atlanta Jan 7-9, 2028; San Diego Jan 5-7, 2029.

series.name: Econometric Society North American Summer Meeting
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.site_note: Each edition is hosted by a university that may run its own meeting site; the Econometric Society's North America events page links to each edition.
series.notes: Since 2026 the Society's primary North American meeting (previously the Winter Meeting). Submitting author must be an Econometric Society member.

series.name: Econometric Society North American Winter Meeting (at ASSA)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Held as part of the ASSA meeting. At least one co-author must be an Econometric Society member; one paper per presenter. Continuation after the January 2027 edition not yet confirmed (NASM became the primary North American meeting in 2026).

series.name: Southern Economic Association Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Southern Economic Association (SEA)
series.notes: Abstract-only submission; USD 35 fee per individual paper (waived within complete session proposals).

series.name: Western Economic Association International Annual Conference
series.organizer: Western Economic Association International (WEAI)
series.notes: Abstract (350 words) submission requires paying submission + registration fee up front (registration refundable if rejected). WEAI's separate International (Pacific Rim) conference is not covered here.

series.name: Midwest Economics Association Annual Meetings
series.organizer: Midwest Economics Association (MEA)
series.notes: One-page abstract; MEA membership required to submit (membership + submission fee paid at submission).

series.name: Canadian Economics Association Annual Conference
series.organizer: Canadian Economics Association (CEA)
series.site_note: Each edition has a page on economics.ca (e.g. https://www.economics.ca/cea-2027).
series.notes: Includes an online day about a week before the in-person meeting. 2027 hosted by Wilfrid Laurier University.

series.name: International Economic Association World Congress
series.organizer: International Economic Association (IEA)
series.site_note: Each congress has its own website (e.g. ieawc2026.org); find it via iea-world.org.
series.typical_call_posted: July of the year before the congress
series.typical_deadline: Mid-November of the year before the congress
series.notes: Rotates worldwide (2021 Indonesia, 2023 Colombia, 2026 Belgrade). Record editions only if the venue is in an in-scope region. 2029 host not yet chosen (letters of interest due 30 Nov 2026).

series.name: International Industrial Organization Conference (IIOC)
series.organizer: Industrial Organization Society (IOS)
series.notes: Submissions via Editorial Express; no submission fee. Past conferences listed at https://www.indorgsociety.org/history

series.name: EARIE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Association for Research in Industrial Economics (EARIE)
series.typical_conference: last weekend of August / first weekend of September
series.notes: earie.org is behind a bot check and cannot be read automatically; check it manually. One paper per submitter (2025 rule).

series.name: Asia-Pacific Industrial Organization Conference (APIOC)
series.organizer: Asia-Pacific Industrial Organization Society (APIOS)
series.site_note: Each edition also has a host-university page (e.g. https://apios.org.au/apioc-2025/); calls are also posted on Econometric Society Australasia regional news
series.notes: Host rotates around the Asia-Pacific (2025 Brisbane; 2026 Xiamen, China, out of scope). Only editions in Australia/NZ or Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore are in scope.

series.name: MaCCI Annual Conference
series.organizer: Mannheim Centre for Competition and Innovation (MaCCI): ZEW Mannheim and University of Mannheim
series.notes: Competition economics and competition law; conference page URL pattern www.zew.de/MacciAnnual<year>

series.name: CEPR-JIE Conference on Applied Industrial Organization
series.organizer: CEPR and the Journal of Industrial Economics (JIE)
series.notes: Host city rotates within Europe; submissions via CEPR HUB; no registration fee

series.name: ZEW Conference on the Economics of Information and Communication Technologies
series.organizer: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research
series.notes: Heinz Koenig Young Scholar Award (EUR 5,000) for best paper by an author under 35

series.name: TSE Digital Economics Conference
series.organizer: TSE Digital Center, Toulouse School of Economics, with CEPR
series.site_note: Each edition gets a new page on tse-fr.eu (e.g. /conferences/2027-19th-digital-economics-conference)
series.notes: In person only; abstracts considered but papers preferred

series.name: BSE Summer Forum: Applied Industrial Organization
series.organizer: Barcelona School of Economics (BSE) Summer Forum
series.notes: Deadline of past calls not visible after closing

series.name: Society of Labor Economists (SOLE) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Society of Labor Economists (SOLE)
series.typical_deadline: End of October to 1 December (31 Oct 2026 for the 2027 meeting)
series.notes: Every fifth year the meeting is replaced by the joint SOLE-EALE-AASLE World Labor Conference (2025 Toronto; 2030 hosted by AASLE). One submission per person.

series.name: EALE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Association of Labour Economists (EALE)
series.typical_conference: Late August to September (2027: 14-16 October, Munich)
series.notes: Each edition has its own host-university website linked from eale.nl. The EALE Tour (young scholars) is excluded.

series.name: Human Capital Conference (TSE-CEPR)
series.organizer: TSE Human Capital Center with the support of CEPR
series.site_note: Each edition has its own TSE conference page and CEPR event page (1st edition: https://cepr.org/events/1st-human-capital-conference); search 'TSE Human Capital Conference 2027'.
series.notes: Started 2026 (Toulouse, 22-23 June). Next edition announced for 21-22 June 2027. No registration fee in 2026.

series.name: AASLE Annual Conference
series.organizer: Asian and Australasian Society of Labour Economics (AASLE)
series.notes: Rotates around Asia-Pacific. 2026 (Beijing) and 2027 (Ho Chi Minh City) editions are outside the dashboard regions, so no call files for them; past in-scope hosts include Tokyo 2022, Taipei 2023, Singapore 2019, Korea 2018, Australia 2017.

series.name: SOLE-EALE-AASLE World Labor Conference
series.organizer: SOLE, EALE and AASLE (host society rotates)
series.site_note: Posted on the host society's site (2025: SOLE, sole-jole.org; 2030: AASLE, aasle.org/conferences).
series.typical_deadline: 1 December of the preceding year (2025 edition)
series.notes: Sixth World Labor Conference: Toronto, 27-29 June 2025. 2030 edition hosted by AASLE; details to follow.

series.name: Urban Economics Association North American Meeting
series.organizer: Urban Economics Association (UEA)
series.notes: Venue alternates between US and Canadian hosts (Montreal 2025, Chicago 2026). Each edition has a call page at urbaneconomics.org/meetings/uea<year>/call.html; submissions via Editorial Express.

series.name: Urban Economics Association European Meeting
series.organizer: Urban Economics Association (UEA)
series.notes: Call page pattern: urbaneconomics.org/meetings/emuea<year>/call.html. 2027: Sciences Po and PSE, Paris, 27-28 May 2027. No separate UEA Asian meeting or UEA call for ASSA sessions was found.

series.name: AEA Conference on Teaching and Research in Economic Education (CTREE)
series.organizer: American Economic Association, Committee on Economic Education (AEA-CEE)
series.notes: CTREE page URL changes by year (.../economic-education/ctree/<year>).

series.name: AREUEA-ASSA Conference
series.organizer: American Real Estate and Urban Economics Association (AREUEA)
series.notes: AREUEA sessions held with the ASSA/AEA Annual Meeting. Submission link on the AREUEA member-content page. Separate student/post-doc poster call (Nov deadline) not tracked.
